# AIOS Pilot

AIOS is an AI-powered business intelligence operating layer. Its product model connects business signals, business memory, knowledge, executive insight, recommendations, decisions, governed workflows, and learning from outcomes.

## Concepts

- Role-Based Intelligence (RBI) prioritizes information relevant to a person's role within their permitted access.
- Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) defines what a person is authorized to access. RBI does not grant permissions or bypass RBAC.
- Recommendations and workflow actions are distinct. Execution depends on configured permissions, policies, and approval requirements.
